freshFindings.expected: Ask/refuse without guessing an all-car scope.
freshFindings.verdict: FAIL against frozen oracle; route evidence confirms broad expansion. This is a classifier/coverage-family concern, not proven to be introduced by W79.

freshFindings.result: One add_zone scoped to {part:'hood'} despite stale roof provenance.
freshFindings.verdict: PASS control for unrelated target isolation.

results.otherCases: Executed; several frozen expectations could not be judged as owner-reuse positives because this harness intentionally seeded one stale roof and did not seed valid committed owners/registry entries for every prompt. Full per-case queue/reply observations are emitted by the test. No aggregate pass percentage is claimed.

limitations: No actual failed PSD load was executed. The route fixture represents the observed generation-2 owner versus generation-3 committed transaction with local objects.
No browser, native app, renderer, PSD pixels, provider, MCP, or application write was used.
The test does not claim current-owner positive reuse; producer-level explicit-color control is retained separately in the 12-case W79 contract.
W79 candidate does not address the observed ambiguous 'upper body' expansion, and no production repair was authorized in this review lane.
